about: Gate 147 (speed with his data) times the bundle under test against origin/main's app.js in one process, interleaved, 5 blocks each at CPU 4x, and reds a line only when the new is clearly slower (median paired diff above a floor AND median ratio above a ratio) or past a catastrophe ceiling. Graded: the five TC-R223a..d comparison lines and the zero-errors line, at 375x761 (kunal761) and 320x568 (se), about 2 minutes a try per size. Breaks: the Review list renders every game instead of a page; a busy loop on every Review list render; a busy loop at app start (Home). NOT COVERED: a slowdown smaller than about 250 ms at 4x (the gate's measured resolution on this container), and his real phone.

breaks.name: review-renders-every-game
breaks.why: the games list loses its paging and renders all 465 games when Review opens (a second, full render of the list)

breaks.name: busy-loop-on-review-list
breaks.why: a fixed busy loop (6e7 sqrt, about +350-500 ms at 4x) runs on every render of the Review games list

breaks.name: busy-loop-at-home-start
breaks.why: a fixed busy loop (1.6e8 sqrt) runs once as the app mounts, so Home is late [#553 B1: STRENGTHENED from 8e7, never the gate loosened - at 320x568 the 8e7 loop read ratio 1.24, 1.27, 1.32, 1.32 against the 1.25 line over four runs, so it could fall under; see the job record]
